title: Slagroomtaart
hookLine: Global-inspired slagroomtaart with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Slagroomtaart
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat the eggs, sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. I beat this in a stand mixer on medium-high speed for about 10 minutes. Incorporate {m53395_1}, {m53395_2}, {m53395_3}, and {m53395_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure eggs first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Slagroomtaart
steps.instructionTemplate: Sift the flour and cornstarch and add to the mixture. Fold this gently into the mixture; you don’t want all the air you whipped in to disappear. Incorporate {m53395_5}, {m53395_6}, {m53395_7}, {m53395_8}, {m53395_9}, and {m53395_10} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Slagroomtaart
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the batter into a greased baking pan. Bake the cake base at 180°C/350°F (conventional oven) for 30 minutes. The cake is done when you press lightly on the top and it springs back. Allow the cake to cool in the pan for a few minutes before removing it to a cake rack.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Slagroomtaart
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, prepare the nougatine and jam according to the recipe if you haven’t already. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Slagroomtaart
steps.instructionTemplate: Let the cake cool completely before you cut it. If, like me, you used a 20 cm/8 inch spring form pan, cut the cake into three layers.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
